readerCopy.body: You can keep fighting the obstacle in front of you and still avoid the move that would change the larger pattern. When Mars squares the North Node, the same argument, emergency, deadline, or source of frustration can consume your energy while the more consequential decision keeps getting postponed. The anger may be justified, but winning another round of the old fight will not automatically create a different result. Handle what genuinely needs action, then put some of that force behind the decision that changes the arrangement instead of only resisting it.
